10) 'Fill in the gaps with the comparative or superlative form of the adjectives in brackets.' 1 That was ...... (bad) film of all. 2 Your car is ...... (expensive) mine. 3 Winnie's makes ...... (good) hamburgers in the city. 4 My suitcase is ...... (heavy) yours. 5 Bill is ...... (old) in his family. 6 I think Paris is ...... (beautiful) city in the world. 7 A mouse is ...... (small) a horse. 8 I am ...... (tall) my sister. 9 What is ...... (big) department store in your city? 10 The bus is ...... (cheap) the train.
11) 'Use the comparative or superlative form of the words in the lists to complete the dialogues below.' Qiya A: 'tasty, expensive, cheap, close'. A: I'm hungry. Let's have dinner at Mario's. B: Mario's? It's 1) ...... restaurant in the city! We haven't got enough money. A: How about Carla's Bistro? It's 2) ...... Mario's. B: That's true, but it's far away. A: I know! Let's go to The Chicken Shack. It's very near, in fact it's 3) ...... of all three restaurants and it has 4) ...... chicken wings around! B: Great idea! Let's go!
  Qiya B: 'big, small, good, beautiful'. T: Hi, Paula! How are you? P: Hi, Tanya. I'm fine, thanks. I heard you moved house. T: Yes, I live in Rosedale now. P: Oh, Rosedale is lovely! It's 1) ...... area in the city. T: Yes, it is. I love my new house. It's got four bedrooms so it's much 2) ...... my last one. The garden is 3) ...... my old one, but I don't mind. P: Rosedale also has 4) ...... views of the city, doesn't it? T: Yes, it does. You must come for a visit soon. P: Sure!

O'NG USTUN:
12) 'Read the information about the two cars below, then complete the sentences, as in the example.' A (qizil sport mashina - Ferrari): 'This car is two years old. It has a top speed of 160 miles per hour. It's for sale at £18,000.' B (kichik eski mashina - Mini): 'This car is ten years old. It has a top speed of 100 miles per hour. It's for sale at £2,000.' 1 Car A is ...bigger than Car B... (big) 2 Car B is ...... (old) 3 Car A is ...... (fast) 4 Car B is ...... (cheap) 5 Car A is ...... (good)
• 'Communication: a) Asking about Prices'.
13) 'Look at the pictures below, then use the prompts to make short dialogues, as in the example.' 6 RASM: 1 bananas / £1.10 per kilo; 2 sunglasses / £40; 3 bicycle / £190; 4 umbrella / £15; 5 flowers / £7; 6 briefcase / £50. Qiya namuna: 'SA: Excuse me. How much are these bananas? SB: They're £1.10 per kilo.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '14'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the comparative or superlative form of the adjectives in brackets.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni qavsdagi sifatlarning qiyosiy yoki orttirma darajasi bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
QIYOSIY va ORTTIRMA DARAJA
  (coursebook 22-bet qoidasi).

  QIYOSIY (ikki narsa) + THAN:
    qisqa: -ER (heavier, smaller,
      taller, cheaper)
    uzun: MORE + sifat (more
      expensive)
  ORTTIRMA (hammasidan) + THE:
    qisqa: THE -EST (the oldest,
      the biggest)
    uzun: THE MOST + sifat (the
      most beautiful)


⚠ NOQONUNIY:

  good → better → THE BEST
  bad → worse → THE WORST


⚠ KALIT SO'ZLAR:

  'than', 'mine/yours' → QIYOSIY
  'of all', 'in the city/world/
  family' → ORTTIRMA


⚠ IMLO:

  big → biggER, biggEST (undosh
  ikkilanadi)
  heavy → heavIER (y → i)


⚠ 'THAN MINE / YOURS':

  'more expensive than mine' =
  menikidan qimmatroq.

items.whyUz: ⚠ Ikki mashina → QIYOSIY. Uzun sifat → 'more ... than'.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the comparative or superlative form of the words in the list to complete the dialogue: tasty, expensive, cheap, close.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlarning qiyosiy yoki orttirma darajasi bilan dialogni to'ldiring: tasty, expensive, cheap, close.
exercises.explanationUz:
RESTORAN TANLASh - QIYOS.

  1 'restaurant in the city' →
    ORTTIRMA: the most expensive
  2 'than Mario's' → QIYOSIY:
    cheaper than
  3 'of all three restaurants' →
    ORTTIRMA: the closest
  4 'chicken wings around' (eng
    mazali) → ORTTIRMA: the
    tastiest


⚠ 'CLOSE' → 'CLOSEST':

  close = yaqin. /kləʊs/ (sifat).
  ⚠ 'close' fe'li /kləʊz/ = yopmoq.


⚠ 'TASTY' → 'TASTIEST':

  y → i + est.


⚠ 'WE HAVEN'T GOT ENOUGH MONEY':

  = pulimiz yetarli emas.
  'enough' = yetarli.


⚠ 'FAR AWAY':

  = uzoqda.


⚠ 'CHICKEN WINGS':

  = tovuq qanotlari.


⚠ 'AROUND':

  = atrofda, bu yerlarda.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm hungry. Let's have dinner at Mario's.
lines.uz: Qornim och. Marioda kechki ovqat qilaylik.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Mario's? It's 1) ___ restaurant in the city! We haven't got enough money.
lines.uz: Mariomi? U shahardagi eng qimmat restoran! Pulimiz yetarli emas.
lines.whyUz: ⚠ 'in the city' → ORTTIRMA. Uzun sifat → 'the most expensive'.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How about Carla's Bistro? It's 2) ___ Mario's.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That's true, but it's far away.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I know! Let's go to The Chicken Shack. It's very near, in fact it's 3) ___ of all three restaurants and it has 4) ___ chicken wings around!
lines.uz: Bildim! Chicken Shackka boraylik. U juda yaqin, aslida uchala restoran ichida eng yaqini va bu yerlardagi eng mazali tovuq qanotlari unda!
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'of all three' → ORTTIRMA: 'the closest'.
⚠ Eng mazali → 'the tastiest' (y → i).

exercises.instructionEn: Use the comparative or superlative form of the words in the list to complete the dialogue: big, small, good, beautiful.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlarning qiyosiy yoki orttirma darajasi bilan dialogni to'ldiring: big, small, good, beautiful.
exercises.explanationUz:
YANGI UY - QIYOS.

  1 'area in the city' → ORTTIRMA:
    the most beautiful
  2 'much ... my last one' (4 yotoq
    xona) → QIYOSIY: bigger than
  3 'my old one, but I don't mind'
    (kamchilik) → QIYOSIY: smaller
    than
  4 'views of the city' → ORTTIRMA:
    the best


⚠ 'MUCH + QIYOSIY':

  'much bigger' = ancha kattaroq.
  ('very bigger' - XATO!)


⚠ 'I DON'T MIND':

  = qarshi emasman, farqi yo'q.


⚠ 'TO MOVE HOUSE':

  = ko'chib o'tmoq.


⚠ 'AN AREA':

  = hudud, mavze.


⚠ 'A VIEW':

  = manzara. 'views of the city' =
  shahar manzaralari.

lines.speaker: P
lines.en: Hi, Tanya. I'm fine, thanks. I heard you moved house.
lines.uz: Salom, Tanya. Yaxshiman, rahmat. Ko'chib o'tibsan deb eshitdim.

lines.speaker: T
lines.en: Yes, I live in Rosedale now.

lines.speaker: P
lines.en: Oh, Rosedale is lovely! It's 1) ___ area in the city.
lines.uz: O, Rouzdeyl ajoyib! U shahardagi eng go'zal mavze.

lines.speaker: T
lines.en: Yes, it is. I love my new house. It's got four bedrooms so it's much 2) ___ my last one. The garden is 3) ___ my old one, but I don't mind.
lines.uz: Ha. Yangi uyimni yaxshi ko'raman. To'rtta yotoqxonasi bor, shuning uchun oldingisidan ancha kattaroq. Bog' eskisidan kichikroq, lekin qarshi emasman.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'much ... than' → 'bigger than' (4 xona).
⚠ 'but I don't mind' → kamchilik → 'smaller than'.

lines.speaker: P
lines.en: Rosedale also has 4) ___ views of the city, doesn't it?
lines.uz: Rouzdeylda shaharning eng yaxshi manzaralari ham bor, shundaymi?

lines.speaker: T
lines.en: Yes, it does. You must come for a visit soon.
lines.uz: Ha. Tez orada mehmonga kelishing kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the information about the two cars below, then complete the sentences, as in the example. Car A: This car is two years old. It has a top speed of 160 miles per hour. It's for sale at £18,000. Car B: This car is ten years old. It has a top speed of 100 miles per hour. It's for sale at £2,000. Example: Car A is bigger than Car B. (big)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ikki mashina haqidagi ma'lumotni o'qing, so'ng gaplarni to'ldiring, namunadagidek. A mashina: Bu mashina ikki yoshda. Eng yuqori tezligi soatiga 160 mil. £18,000 ga sotiladi. B mashina: Bu mashina o'n yoshda. Eng yuqori tezligi soatiga 100 mil. £2,000 ga sotiladi. Namuna: A mashina B mashinadan kattaroq. (big)
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI MAShINA - QIYOSIY DARAJA
  + THAN.

  A: 2 yosh, 160 mil/soat, £18,000
  B: 10 yosh, 100 mil/soat, £2,000

  ⚠ Hamma gap QIYOSIY (ikki
  mashina):
  2 B is OLDER than A (10 > 2)
  3 A is FASTER than B (160 > 100)
  4 B is CHEAPER than A (£2,000)
  5 A is BETTER than B (good →
    better)


⚠ 'TOP SPEED':

  = eng yuqori tezlik.
  'miles per hour' (mph) = soatiga
  mil (1 mil = 1,6 km).


⚠ 'FOR SALE AT £...':

  = ... narxda sotuvda.


⚠ £18,000 = eighteen thousand
  pounds.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures below, then use the prompts to make short dialogues, as in the example. 1 bananas / £1.10 per kilo 2 sunglasses / £40 3 bicycle / £190 4 umbrella / £15 5 flowers / £7 6 briefcase / £50
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi rasmlarga qarang, so'ng ko'rsatmalar bilan qisqa dialoglar tuzing, namunadagidek. 1 bananas / £1.10 per kilo 2 sunglasses / £40 3 bicycle / £190 4 umbrella / £15 5 flowers / £7 6 briefcase / £50
exercises.explanationUz:
NARX SO'RASh (coursebook 22-bet
  24-mashq).

  KO'PLIK: How much ARE these
    bananas? - They're £1.10.
  BIRLIK: How much IS this
    bicycle? - It's £190.

  ⚠ 'sunglasses', 'flowers' -
  KO'PLIK → 'are these ... They're'.
  ⚠ 'bicycle', 'umbrella',
  'briefcase' - BIRLIK → 'is this
  ... It's'.


⚠ 'HOW MUCH':

  = qancha (narx). 'How much is
  it?' = Bu qancha turadi?


⚠ 'PER KILO':

  = kilosiga. £1.10 = one pound
  ten (pence).


⚠ NARXLARNI O'QISh:

  £40 = forty pounds
  £190 = a hundred and ninety
    pounds
  £1.10 = one pound ten


⚠ 'EXCUSE ME':

  = kechirasiz (e'tibor jalb
  qilish).
